mission: Frank v0.1 voll lauffähig auf Andreas PC

supported_points: Rule aliases become parse-tree branch names.
Rule structure and aliases therefore preserve identifier-position context independently of the literal token value.
Named terminals and rule branches are distinct tree-construction signals; post-parse semantic extraction should use the grammar context rather than globally filtering token strings.

hypothesis: PR145's AST-context identifier extraction correctly preserves grammar-admitted reserved-word identifiers, but its ident_* branch should fail closed if replayed/corrupted canonical AST bytes disagree with the alias identity.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Alias/token agreement need not be checked because only the trusted production parser can construct canonical AST values, so an ident_status node can never contain any other literal.

out_of_box_experiment.name: ALIAS_TOKEN_IDENTITY_MISMATCH_MATRIX
out_of_box_experiment.method: Reproduce PR145 direct_identifier semantics over synthetic canonical-AST nodes for every grammar alias. For each alias, first present the matching literal, then mutate only the child literal while retaining the ident_* branch name. Compare current candidate behavior with a minimal fail-closed alias-suffix equality guard.
out_of_box_experiment.mechanism: Current PR145 direct_identifier trusts any single token under an ident_* branch and returns its token value. It does not verify that ident_status carries status, ident_record carries record, etc.

decision.required_minimal_change: For ident_* direct children, require exactly one token and require token value == alias suffix; otherwise raise TypedIRError. Continue accepting direct NAME unchanged.

required_regressions: All grammar-admitted keyword identifiers remain preserved in record/field/fn/typed-param/interface/method/param positions.
All 24 current ident_* aliases accept their exact matching literal.
Malformed ident_* with zero or multiple token values fails closed.
Full frozen G9 + Dialect deterministic typed-IR replay remains unchanged under the selected exact grammar provenance.
No syntax/semantic/contract hash is renamed or promoted by this hardening alone.

coordination.collision_policy: Do not mutate active parser/V20 lanes. Route only this independent typed-IR integrity obligation to the PR145/WP03 owner lane.

next_frontier: Apply the alias/token equality guard on the PR145 candidate branch, not main, and add the mutation matrix regression.
Replay the hardened candidate against the exact selected WP03 grammar/frontend provenance and frozen G9+Dialect.
Materialize hosted/self-hosted Ubuntu receipts; distinguish transport failure from scientific failure.
Only after the selected grammar and hardened typed-IR candidate jointly pass should WP03 merge/promotion be reconsidered.
Registered Andreas Ubuntu developer-system evidence remains the formal BASE acceptance authority.
